classification: bounded subordinate geometric paired-source producer and coherent legal-effect readout consumer

conditions.effect: For each total-number sector, the compressed matrix and its complement are positive semidefinite. Concrete passive-loss Gamma construction and infinite-Fock Hilbert/unitary realization remain separate statements.
conditions.numeric: Concrete Gamma(E), Gaussian vacuum determinant, five-pulse threshold/OR readout and empirical CI membership are consumed by independent numeric programs, not these Lean mouths.
conditions.seed: N,L,A,B positive with N*L-A*B positive; seven-coordinate phase has a legal cosine. Calibration readback concerns N*n*T and N*n*(1+n)*TA*TB, not equality with observed threshold rates.
conditions.source: Paired geometric amplitudes with legal raw ratios and unit-circle phase. Their amplitude mass and count PGF are derived, not source premises.
conditions.tail: The complete paired support is partitioned by total h+v. A cutoff is a numerical prefix, never a normalized physical source; omitted Born contribution lies in [0,sourceTail].

focused_verification.command_path_convention: Source keys are repository-relative. argv paths are relative to Lean/. ${fresh_olean} replaces only the task-owned temporary output path.

scope: Two legal raw geometric ratios and a unit-circle phase generate all paired number amplitudes, unit total mass, the count PGF and every mixed factorial moment. The same coherent sector vector and any positive contractive number-conserving compressed effect generate fullBorn, prefixBorn and an exact omitted-sector probability budget. Source seed geometry generates raw ratios and phase; its moment readbacks retain explicit legal denominators.

source_audit.effect_data: NumberConservingEffect supplies actual finite compressed matrices with positive matrix and positive I-matrix. These are legal readout effects, not completed source or probability witnesses. The source vector retains off-diagonal coherent quadratic terms.
source_audit.primitive_data: Raw tH,tV in [0,1) and one unit-circle phase; no total source normalization, count PGF, covariance, Wick, target rates or Born certificate. SevenSeed provides geometric data and legal raw ratio/phase conditions.
